info.name: ASG Shipping - Demurrage Enquiry BL wise (100-144)
info.description:
Demurrage Enquiry - BL wise (Shipping -> Transactions, document 100-144).

Display only document: nothing is persisted, every figure is derived from the BL, the line tariff and the charge masters.

## Setup
1. Select the environment / edit the collection variables: `baseUrl`, `token`, `blPoid`.
2. `token` is a bearer JWT - the company, group, user and document context are read from it.
3. Run **Apply Date** first; it fills `blPoid` driven results and stores the calculated totals in collection variables for the follow up requests.

## Flow on the screen
- `GET /bl-details` - runs when a BL is picked in the ALLBLNUMBER LOV
- `POST /apply-date` - the Apply Date button (containers + charges + totals)
- `GET /demurrage-calculation` - the View Demurrage Calculation link (PDF)
- `POST /list` - List of Records common feature

request.description:
Loads the containers of the BL: SOC flag, container number, ISO type, free days, demurrage start date, Empty In date, plus the delivery order status (DOISSUED / DONOTISSUED).

The To Date, Days and Amount columns come back empty - they are only filled by **Apply Date**, matching the legacy screen.

Requires role right VIEW. Returns 404 when the BL does not exist or is deleted.

request.description:
The **Apply Date** button.

Recalculates the demurrage of every container of the BL up to the given To Date and reloads the Charges tab.

### Business rules
- `toDate` defaults to the current date when omitted or null
- A container returned empty is charged only up to its **Empty In** date
- Containers still inside their free days come back with 0 days / 0 amount
- `discountPercentage` (0 - 100) is applied on the calculated demurrage of every container
- Charges tab = uninvoiced BL manifest charges + the calculated demurrage (charge mapped on the SHDEMURRAGE global parameter) + late collection / revalidation port charges
- `receiptAmount` excludes tax, `totalAmountWithVat` = `receiptAmount` + `totalTaxAmount`

request.description: Only `blPoid` is mandatory. `toDate` falls back to the current date in the user time zone and `discountPercentage` to 0, exactly like the screen defaults.

query.description: Optional, ISO yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to the current date.

request.description:
The **View Demurrage Calculation** link - renders `Shipping/SH/LINE_DEMURRAGE_CALC.jrxml` (with the LINE_DEMURRAGE_MASTER and LINE_DEMURRAGE_DTL subreports) as a PDF.

Requires role right PRINT. Use *Send and Download* in Postman to save the file.

Report parameters sent by the service: `DOC_ID=100-144`, `DOC_KEY_POID=<blPoid>`, `P_TILL_DATE` (dd-MMM-yyyy), `P_DISCOUNT`.

On a failure the endpoint answers 500 with a JSON body instead of a PDF.

query.description: Optional. Must be supplied together with endDate.
Optional. Must be supplied together with startDate.

request.description:
List of Records common feature, filtered and paginated through the shared document search on document 100-144.

The request body is optional. `startDate` and `endDate` must be supplied together, otherwise the endpoint answers 400.
